items.definition: İnce mantıksal ayrımlar ilişkisine dayanan on cümle tamamlama sorusu.

questions.prompt: The proposal is unlikely to be accepted, let alone ----.
options: to implement it in full
implemented in full
being implemented in full
implementing in full
it has been implemented in full
questions.explanationTR: «Let alone» kalıbında iki öğe paralel kurulur: accepted ... implemented (ikisi de V3): (B). (A) ve (D) paralelliği bozar. (C) ve (E) edilgen ya da cümlecik yapısı karıştırır.

questions.prompt: The lecture was not so much boring as ----.
options: badly organised
organising badly
because it was badly organised
was badly organised
badly organise
questions.explanationTR: «Not so much A as B» kalıbında A ve B paralel olmalıdır: boring ... badly organised (sıfat + sıfat): (A). (B) fiil yapısıdır ve boring ile paralel değildir. (C) because ile ikinci bir bağlaç ekler. (D) özne eksik, çekimli bir fiil koyar. (E) yalın fiildir ve sıfatla paralel kurulamaz.

questions.prompt: Apart from ----, the visitors enjoyed the trip.
options: to be delayed long at the border
the border was long delayed
they were delayed long at the border
delayed long at the border
the long delay at the border
questions.explanationTR: «Apart from» bir edattır ve ardından ad öbeği gelir: the long delay at the border: (E). (A) mastar yapısıdır. (B) ve (C) tam cümlecik kurar, oysa edattan sonra cümlecik gelmez. (D) «being» olmadan kullanılan bir ortaçtır ve edat sonrasında kurulamaz.

options: better as the researchers had expected
more better than the researchers had expected
better that the researchers expected
better than the researchers had expected
better than that the researchers had expected
questions.explanationTR: «If anything» kalıbından sonra karşılaştırma kurulur: better than the researchers had expected: (D). (A) as ve (C) that karşılaştırma bağlacı değildir. (B) more better çift karşılaştırma yapar. (E) than'dan sonra fazladan that koyar.

options: did the university admit its first female professor
the university has admitted its first female professor
the university admitted its first female professor
had the university admitted its first female professor
when the university admitted its first female professor
questions.explanationTR: «It was not until ... that» vurgu kalıbında that'ten sonra DÜZ cümle sırası gelir ve geçmiş zaman kullanılır: (C). (A) ve (D) devrik sıra kurar. (B) present perfect, 1990 gibi belirli bir yılla kullanılamaz. (E) when ikinci bir bağlaç ekler.

options: any such agreement had ever been signed
any such agreement was ever signing
any such agreement to have been signed
whether any such agreement had ever been signed
any such agreement being ever signed
questions.explanationTR: «Deny that» ardından tam bir cümlecik ister ve önceki olay past perfect ile verilir: had ever been signed: (A). (B), (C) ve (E) cümlecik kurmaz ya da edilgen yapıyı bozar. (D) deny that kalıbından sonra ikinci bir bağlaç (whether) ekler.

questions.prompt: The company would have avoided bankruptcy had it not been for ----.
options: its largest customer collapsed suddenly
the largest customer has suddenly collapsed
that its largest customer would collapse
suddenly its largest customer collapsed
the sudden collapse of its largest customer
questions.explanationTR: «Had it not been for» ardından bir AD ÖBEĞİ gelir: the sudden collapse of its largest customer: (E). (A), (B), (C) ve (D) cümlecik ya da yanlış yapıdır; «had it not been for» ardından cümlecik almaz.

questions.prompt: Much as the public admired the scientists, ----.
options: it admired them greatly
it was unwilling to pay higher taxes to fund their research
the scientists admired the public
admiration was expressed in many letters
higher taxes had already funded the research
questions.explanationTR: «Much as» bir KARŞITLIK (concession) kurar: halk bilim insanlarına hayranlık duysa da araştırmaları için vergi ödemeye isteksizdi: (B). (A) hayranlığı tekrar eder. (C) özneleri değiştirir. (D) ve (E) karşıtlık içermez.

questions.prompt: The project was completed under budget, which meant that ----.
options: the budget had been exceeded by several million
the project was cancelled before it began
the surplus could be used for another scheme
the surplus had been spent already
it should have cost more
questions.explanationTR: «Under budget» bütçenin altında kalmak demektir ve sonucu artan paranın başka bir işe kullanılabilmesidir: (C). (A) bütçenin aşıldığını söyler. (B) proje tamamlandığı için iptal ile çelişir. (D) artan parayı harcanmış sayar. (E) «under budget» ile çelişir.

questions.prompt: In spite of the fact that ----.
options: overwhelming evidence, the jury took three days to reach a verdict
the evidence overwhelming, the jury took three days to reach a verdict
the evidence being overwhelming, the jury took three days to reach a verdict
the evidence was overwhelming, the jury took three days to reach a verdict
the evidence was overwhelming so the jury took three days to reach a verdict
questions.explanationTR: «In spite of the fact that» ardından tam bir cümlecik gelir ve karşıtlık kurulur: the evidence was overwhelming, the jury took ...: (D). (A) cümlecik yerine ad öbeği koyar. (B) ve (C) yapıyı bozar. (E) so ile anlamı tersine çevirir.
